start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-c.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=UTC && rm -f eval-c.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-c-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend only; npm start does not exist until E5-S1. DATABASE_PATH is relative to backend/, so sqlite3 inspection targets backend/eval-c.db. JWT_SECRET is exported explicitly (min 32 bytes); after C-UR-1 it is mandatory outside APP_ENV=dev, so the start command must keep exporting it. Live protected routes available in group C: GET /api/auth/me (added by E1-S4) and whatever exists from earlier groups. Doctor-only, admin and appointment-ownership routes (E2-S2, E2-S3, E3-S2) do not exist yet, so role/ownership rules (AC2, AC3, AC5) are verified at pytest level through test-only routes mounted on a test app that use the real get_current_user/require_roles/access.py, plus live checks on /api/auth/me. The admin user for live checks is inserted via sqlite3 (argon2 hash generated with uv run python) because no admin bootstrap endpoint exists.

user_requested_additions.title: Remove the committed default JWT secret
requirements: Remove the fixed committed DEV_JWT_SECRET default from backend/src/telemed/config/settings.py (currently line 8 constant and line 20 default; consumed via service/bootstrap.py line 35 and service/container.py line 47). jwt_secret must come from the environment.

Startup is refused (clear error naming JWT_SECRET, never echoing the value) when JWT_SECRET is missing, or equal to the old dev value 'dev-only-insecure-jwt-secret-change-me-0123456789', unless APP_ENV=dev.

In dev (APP_ENV=dev) and in tests, when JWT_SECRET is missing generate a random per-process secret (e.g. secrets.token_urlsafe(48)) instead of any fixed string; it must not be logged or appear in repr(settings).
Keep the 32-byte minimum for any supplied secret (existing test_short_jwt_secret_rejected must still pass).

Add an APP_ENV setting (dev/staging/prod, default dev per specs/design/deployment.md) if Settings does not already have one. Note: a default of dev means an unset APP_ENV permits the random per-process secret, which is acceptable because it is never a fixed string.
A test tagged NFR-04 asserts the app refuses to start with the dev default outside dev (and with a missing secret outside dev).

.env.example (project root) must not carry the fixed secret as a working default: remove the value (blank or a placeholder that fails validation, with a comment to generate one, e.g. python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))").

Existing tests that relied on the fixed default (tests/unit/test_settings.py::test_jwt_secret_default_is_long_enough_and_hidden and any conftest) are updated to set JWT_SECRET explicitly or assert the random per-process behaviour.

content_rules: E1-S4 AC2: api/deps.py get_current_user loads the user row from the database on every request and takes the role from users.role; the role claim in the JWT is never used for authorization decisions
E1-S4 AC4: get_current_user rejects users with is_active false with 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; no in-process cache of user/role between requests
E1-S4 AC1: invalid, malformed, expired, wrong-signature and alg=none tokens all map to 401 UNAUTHENTICATED with the generic error body (no exception text echoed)

E1-S4 AC3: require_roles raises 403 FORBIDDEN; ownership checks live in service/access.py and raise NotFound (404) for both missing and foreign objects with identical bodies; ADMIN bypass is explicit in access.py

E1-S4: /api/auth/me added to api/routers/auth.py and protected by get_current_user; users_repo.py gains the by-id lookup; layering respected (api/deps.py does not touch sqlite directly, goes via the service/repository layer)

C-UR-1: grep of backend/src and .env.example finds no occurrence of the literal 'dev-only-insecure-jwt-secret-change-me-0123456789' as a default value (it may appear only as a constant in the refusal denylist, if kept)
C-UR-1: settings.py jwt_secret has no fixed-string default; dev fallback uses the secrets module

review_notes: Lean mode: only checks mapped to E1-S4 acceptance criteria F017-F021 plus the user-requested addition; generic lint/coverage/size gates omitted as in groups A and B.
No design or playwright checks: E1-S4 is an API-layer story with no UI (design_checks and playwright_checks are empty on purpose).

Role and ownership rules AC2/AC3/AC5 cannot be fully exercised live because admin, doctor-only and appointment routes do not exist until later groups; they are verified with pytest test-only routes that mount the real get_current_user, require_roles and access.py, plus live /api/auth/me checks. Real routes should be added to the live checks if present at evaluation time (C-API-3c).

C-UR-1 is beyond the E1-S4 acceptance criteria and was requested by the user following a security review; it is tagged NFR-04 (the same brief criterion E1-S4 covers) and has no features.json entry (feature null). Evaluator should treat C-UR-1-a/b as required for group C, and should consider adding a features.json entry if the harness requires one.
Group C start_command exports JWT_SECRET explicitly because C-UR-1 makes it mandatory outside dev.

Note on spec mismatch: specs/design/deployment.md names a different dev default ('change-me-in-development') than the code and .env.example; C-UR-1 supersedes both: no fixed default at all. deployment.md should be updated by the generator to match.
Test file names follow specs/design/component-map.md (E1-S4 row); test_settings.py is an existing file modified for C-UR-1.

Reviewed against E1-S4 ACs and api-contracts: added C-API-1e (401 precedes 403/404 on role routes), tightened C-API-1d to the full API-05 User shape, scoped C-API-5a admin bypass to id-addressed reads per api-contracts 0.2, removed the unrequested ADMIN-deactivation extra from C-API-4b. C-UR-1 retained unchanged.
